summary: Maharashtra and Buldhana first-party pages establish official land-map/land-record services and link Mahabhunakasha/BhuNaksha, but the live viewer timed out before returning its current JavaScript/configuration or any bounded Khamgaon parcel response. No safe native ID, schema, CRS, or polygon was verified.
queryAndRequestOutcomes: Separate English and Marathi discovery queries were executed and recorded in city-9225-khamgaon.json. Official Buldhana and Maharashtra pages were inspected. A bounded anonymous GET to the official BhuNaksha viewer timed out after 30 seconds; no credentials, private tokens, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, unsafe lookup, or TLS-verification disablement was used.
cityOrLocalCustodian: No Khamgaon-local registry/cadastre custodian was established. Buldhana district administration and Maharashtra Bhumi Abhilekh are first-party district/state sources documenting services, but they do not by themselves prove a city-specific public parcel endpoint.
routesAttempted: All discovery URLs, route methods, and outcomes are recorded in city-9225-khamgaon.json.
